# hermes-lcm v0.23.0

Stable promotion of the accepted isolation-only RC2 candidate. Runtime and schema behavior
are byte-identical to `v0.23.0-rc2`; only release identity and metadata change. The underlying
correctness batch contains 17 adversarially reviewed PRs with RED/GREEN receipts; every
score-sensitive change carries an architect verdict (#252) and a `bench/BASELINE-LEDGER.md`
boundary row.

## Highlights
- Replay-proof hardening: replay proofs are occurrence-bounded and tool-identified (#177),
  out-of-band block durability binds to unique row identity with ID-less rows failing
  closed (#203), and the vetoed fork-guard is removed with its drop contract fenced (#259).
  Ambiguity now always resolves to visible duplication, never silent loss.
- Retrieval: a slow full-text arm can no longer starve semantic recall (#173); summary DAG
  expansion works across sessions with correct provenance (#183); sessions can be excluded
  from retrieval (#184); a crashed search arm discloses instead of reporting 'ok' (#273).
- Integrity state publishes only with proof valid at publish time: verified-pass clearing
  and a CAS-fenced background-scan publish that errs toward recorded evidence (#261).
- Teams candidate machinery lands DORMANT: the AccessContextV1 contract package (#286) —
  pure additive, nothing consumes it, single-user behavior unchanged; enablement stays a
  separate pilot-gated decision (#75/#83).

## Changes
- #325 — release validation forces private output-local storage and per-test databases;
  inherited live-profile storage selectors are ignored. No runtime or schema code changed.
- #177 #203 #259 — reconcile/replay-proof (see Highlights; #177 note: replay-snapshot
  digests change once, so the first post-upgrade restart re-persists instead of matching).
- #173 #183 #184 #273 #172 — retrieval (incl. configurable Voyage reranker, #172).
- #261 #179 #168 #198 — ops: FTS bootstrap race + integrity-publish contract; doctor
  payload-ref provenance; durable compaction totals in status (accuracy contract #288);
  separate summary/expansion reasoning controls with warn-and-ignore config posture.
- #196 — expand-query answers carry bounded, tool-extracted evidence provenance.
- #297 — P1 #90 fixed: compaction's auto-derived focus keeps the NEWEST user request
  authoritative for over-cap host-composed turns (middle-elision clamps; block budget spent
  newest-backwards). Summary-steering ledger row appended per the architect verdict.
- #286 — Teams slice 1 (AccessContextV1), dormant.
- #254 #257 — regression coverage salvaged from closed PRs; #262 — gpt-5.4 retirement note.
- #241 (governance) — the main ruleset is satisfiable again: phantom CodeQL contexts
  dropped, last-push-approval deadlock removed; --admin is an exception, not the path.

## Not included (tracked)
- #244, #288, #265, #260, #298 — accepted follow-ups / queued contract rulings with revisit
  triggers. Teams slices 2–5 — v0.24.0, dormant, architect-gated per slice. Architect-held
  PRs (#161 #163 #165 #191 #201 #205) and the owner queue — unchanged.
